notes: A frozen lookup table, not an algorithm. Text absent from `vectors` is a hard error rather than a hashed fallback: a fallback would be an algorithm, and an algorithm shared with the code under test would destroy oracle independence.
Vectors are chosen so cosine, L2 and inner-product rank the same corpus in three DIFFERENT orders. If any two metrics agreed, a Store that silently ignored distanceMetric would pass all three.
alpha and beta share a direction but differ in magnitude. Cosine nearly ties them while L2 and inner product separate them strongly: that pair is the normalisation control.
wrongdim is deliberately 9-dimensional, for the dimension-mismatch cases.
